newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Mandela ends Philippine visit, flies to Brunei.
newsitem.headline: Mandela ends Philippine visit, flies to Brunei.

text.p: South African President Nelson Mandela left the Philippines for Brunei on Monday after a two-day official visit during which he urged closer economic ties with Asia.
Mandela met Philippine President Fidel Ramos, former Philippine president Corazon Aquino and the country's top businessmen during his stay in the country.
Mandela was accompanied for the first time on a state visit by his companion Graca Machel, the 51-year-old widow of former Mozambican President Samora Machel.
Mandela was seen off by Philippine officials led by vice president Joseph Estrada in a simple ceremony. Ramos left the country on Sunday on a 10-day tour of south Asia and the Middle East.
After Brunei, Mandela is set to visit Malaysia and Singapore before returning to South Africa.
